rows: Resolve a minified (gen_line, gen_col) position to its original STRUCT(source, src_line, src_col, name) using nearest-preceding source-map semantics; NULL if the map is missing/malformed or the position precedes the first mapping

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Resolve one minified (generated) line/column position back to its original source location using nearest-preceding source-map semantics. Returns a `STRUCT(source VARCHAR, src_line BIGINT, src_col BIGINT, name VARCHAR)`. The `map` argument is a path to a .map file, the raw map JSON text, or map `BLOB` bytes. All line/column numbers are 0-indexed. Returns NULL when the map is NULL, malformed, or empty, when a position is NULL, or when the position precedes the first mapping. Use it to de-minify a single error frame.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Resolve a minified `(gen_line, gen_col)` to its original `STRUCT(source, src_line, src_col, name)`, e.g. `lookup(read_text(map_path), line, col)`. Nearest-preceding; 0-indexed; NULL on no match.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Resolve a generated line/column back to its original location.","sql":"SELECT sourcemap.main.lookup('{\"version\":3,\"sources\":[\"index.js\"],\"names\":[],\"mappings\":\"AAAA\"}', 0, 0);"}]
rows.vgi.keywords: ["lookup","resolve","de-minify","deminify","source map","original position","stack frame","symbolicate","line column","nearest preceding","RUM","error tracking"]
rows.vgi.title: Resolve Minified Position

rows: STRUCT("source" VARCHAR, src_line BIGINT, src_col BIGINT, "name" VARCHAR)
Bulk-resolve a column of minified frames against one map (id passthrough)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Resolve a whole column of minified (line, col) error frames against ONE source map, returning the original (source, src_line, src_col, name) for each — with the input id column passed through so the result joins back to the originating row. The input relation is supplied as a subquery (e.g. `(SELECT id, line, col FROM frames)`); the single map is the named `map :=` argument (a .map path, raw JSON text, or `BLOB`). Name the id/line/col columns with `id :=` / `line :=` / `col :=` (defaults 'id', 'line', 'col'). Positions are 0-indexed; resolution is nearest-preceding. A malformed map, NULL position, or no-match yields NULL resolution columns for that row (the id still passes through). This is the bulk de-minify entry point for RUM / error-tracking frames.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Bulk-resolve a column of minified `(line, col)` frames against one map, with `id` passthrough: `lookup_all((SELECT id, line, col FROM frames), map := …, id := 'id')`. Emits `(id, source, src_line, src_col, name)`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Resolve a column of frames against one inline map, joining back by id.","sql":"SELECT r.id, r.source, r.src_line FROM sourcemap.main.lookup_all((SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 0, 0)) AS f(id, line, col)), map := '{\"version\":3,\"file\":\"o.js\",\"sources\":[\"index.js\"],\"names\":[],\"mappings\":\"AAAA\"}', id := 'id') AS r"}]
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description":"Resolve a column of frames against one inline map, joining back by id.","sql":"SELECT r.id, r.source, r.src_line FROM sourcemap.main.lookup_all((SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 0, 0)) AS f(id, line, col)), map := '{\"version\":3,\"file\":\"o.js\",\"sources\":[\"index.js\"],\"names\":[],\"mappings\":\"AAAA\"}', id := 'id') AS r"}]
rows.vgi.keywords: ["lookup_all","bulk resolve","de-minify","deminify","error frames","RUM","error tracking","stack frames","id passthrough","symbolicate","table function","resolve column"]
rows.vgi.result_dynamic_columns_md:
The first output column is the **passthrough id** — it takes the exact name and type of the input `id` column (whatever you named via `id :=`), so results join back to the originating row. It is followed by four fixed resolution columns. For an input relation whose id column is a `BIGINT` named `id`, the result columns are:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | BIGINT | Passthrough of the input id column (same name and type as the input). |
| `source` | VARCHAR | Original source file, or NULL when the frame does not resolve. |
| `src_line` | BIGINT | 0-indexed original line, or NULL when unresolved. |
| `src_col` | BIGINT | 0-indexed original column, or NULL when unresolved. |
| `name` | VARCHAR | Original symbol name, or NULL if the mapping carries none. |
rows.vgi.title: Bulk Resolve Minified Frames

rows: Return one row of source-map metadata (version, file, counts)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Return one row of metadata about a Source Map v3 (.map): version, file (the generated file it describes), source_root, n_sources, n_names, and n_mappings (the decoded token count after flattening any sections). The `map` argument is a path to a .map file, the raw map JSON text, or map `BLOB` bytes. Use it to size or sanity-check a map before decoding it in full.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Get one row of map-level metadata (version, file, source_root, n_sources, n_names, n_mappings).
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Read version, source count, and mapping count from an inline map.","sql":"SELECT version, n_sources, n_mappings FROM sourcemap.main.meta('{\"version\":3,\"file\":\"o.js\",\"sources\":[\"index.js\"],\"names\":[],\"mappings\":\"AAAA\"}');"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema:
[
  {"name": "version", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "Source Map spec version (always 3)."},
  {"name": "file", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "The generated (minified) file the map describes, or NULL if unset."},
  {"name": "source_root", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "The map's sourceRoot prefix, or NULL if unset."},
  {"name": "n_sources", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "Number of original source files the map references."},
  {"name": "n_names", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "Number of original symbol names the map carries."},
  {"name": "n_mappings", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "Number of decoded tokens (after flattening any index-map sections)."}
]
rows.vgi.title: Source Map Metadata

rows: Return the inline sourcesContent of one original source (by src_id) embedded in the map, or NULL if absent

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Return the embedded original source text (the map's `sourcesContent`) for one source, identified by its 0-based src_id (matching the sources() table). The `map` argument is a path to a .map file, the raw map JSON text, or map `BLOB` bytes. Returns NULL when the map embeds no content for that id, or when the map is NULL/malformed.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Return the inline `sourcesContent` for a source id, e.g. `source_content(read_text(map_path), 0)`. NULL when no inline content.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Fetch the embedded original source text for source 0.","sql":"SELECT sourcemap.main.source_content('{\"version\":3,\"sources\":[\"a.js\"],\"sourcesContent\":[\"const x = 1;\"],\"names\":[],\"mappings\":\"AAAA\"}', 0);"}]
rows.vgi.title: Inline Source Content

rows: List the original sources of a source map (with inline-content flag)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: List the original source files referenced by a Source Map v3 (.map): one row per source with its 0-based src_id, the source path, and has_content (whether the map embeds that source's text inline via sourcesContent). The `map` argument is a path to a .map file, the raw map JSON text, or map `BLOB` bytes. Use it to discover the originals behind a bundle, then fetch embedded text with source_content(map, src_id).
rows.vgi.doc_md: List a map's original sources (src_id, source, has_content).
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the original source files referenced by an inline map.","sql":"SELECT src_id, source, has_content FROM sourcemap.main.sources('{\"version\":3,\"file\":\"o.js\",\"sources\":[\"index.js\"],\"names\":[],\"mappings\":\"AAAA\"}');"}]
rows.vgi.title: List Source Map Sources

rows: Decode a source map into its full token (mapping) table

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decode a Source Map v3 (.map) into its full token table: one row per Base64-VLQ mapping, in generated order, with columns gen_line, gen_col, src_id, source, src_line, src_col, name. The `map` argument is a path to a .map file, the raw map JSON text, or map `BLOB` bytes. Index maps (sections) are flattened first. All line/column numbers are 0-indexed. Use it to inspect or join the raw mappings of a source map.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Explode a source map into its decoded token table (gen_line, gen_col, src_id, source, src_line, src_col, name).
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Explode an inline source map into its decoded token rows.","sql":"SELECT gen_line, gen_col, source FROM sourcemap.main.tokens('{\"version\":3,\"file\":\"o.js\",\"sources\":[\"index.js\"],\"names\":[],\"mappings\":\"AAAA\"}');"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema:
[
  {"name": "gen_line", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "0-indexed generated (minified) line of this mapping."},
  {"name": "gen_col", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "0-indexed generated (minified) column of this mapping."},
  {"name": "src_id", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "0-based index into sources() of the original file, or NULL if the token has no source."},
  {"name": "source", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Original source file path this mapping points at, or NULL."},
  {"name": "src_line", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "0-indexed original source line, or NULL."},
  {"name": "src_col", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "0-indexed original source column, or NULL."},
  {"name": "name", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Original symbol name for this mapping, or NULL if none."}
]
rows.vgi.title: Decode Source Map Tokens
